record.scientific_question: For each of the four Q041 FULL/start0 configurations explicitly reconstructed in run 38140371059, what rigorously controlled bounds can be placed on the differences in the complete electron-fraction history x_e(z) and cumulative Thomson optical depth tau_T(z) between an event-resolved latch at q=xHeII=10^-6 and a reset to q=0 at the same first cutoff event, with identical captured effective inputs and fixed accepted z_reio?
